requirement: Seven hospitals want to know the total number of ICU patients. Each has at most 10,000. No three hospitals together should be able to see another hospital's count.
Five banks want the product of their two risk scores (each up to 50) computed jointly, and no two banks may collude to learn a score.
Split our vault's 6-digit PIN among 5 directors so that any 3 of them can open it.
Our 4 branch offices (Delhi, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai) want total quarterly revenue in rupees (max 5 lakh each), and it must still work if one office is offline.
Three companies want to compute their combined payroll. No single company should be able to see another company's figure.
10 voters each cast a yes (1) or no (0) vote. We need the tally, and any 4 colluding voters must learn nothing about other votes.
Four parties want to multiply their secret values together, and no two of them may collude to learn anything.
Split a wallet recovery seed among 3 friends; all 3 must be present to recover it.
Eight hospitals want their total treatment cost. The computation must succeed even if 3 hospitals are offline, and no 4 hospitals together may learn another's cost.
Five parties want to sum their bids. No 3 of them may collude, and it must still work with 3 parties offline.
Two companies want the sum of their revenues and neither should learn the other's revenue.
Alice, Bob, Carol and Dave want to compute the sum of their ages; any two of them together can reveal the result.
12 sensors report temperature readings up to 100. We need the total, and it must stay private even if up to 5 sensors are compromised and collude.
A board of 9 members shares a launch code; a simple majority must agree before it can be used.
Three hospitals want the product of their three values, each below 20. No single hospital may learn another's value.
